  * {

  body {
    background-color: #08090b;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 100vh;
    font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
    color: #F4F6FA;
  }

  .mitmarket-slide {
    position: relative;
    width: 1080px;
    height: 460px;
    min-height: 460px;
    max-height: 460px;
    padding: 24px;
    border: 1px solid #293344;
    border-radius: 16px;
    background: #101216;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }

  /* Deep atmospheric background glows */
  .ambient-radar-glow {
    position: absolute;
    top: -40px;
    right: 40px;
    width: 620px;
    height: 480px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle 320px at 65% 42%, rgba(20, 99, 255, 0.16) 0%, rgba(11, 186, 116, 0.08) 45%, rgba(16, 18, 22, 0) 75%);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  .ambient-storm-flare {
    position: absolute;
    top: 70px;
    right: 280px;
    width: 240px;
    height: 240px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.18) 0%, rgba(20, 99, 255, 0.08) 50%, transparent 75%);
    filter: blur(28px);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 1;
    animation: atmosphericPulse 7s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }

  @keyframes atmosphericPulse {
    0% { opacity: 0.55; transform: scale(0.96); }
    100% { opacity: 0.95; transform: scale(1.08); }
  }

  /* Top & Action utility row */
  .slide-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 10;
    height: 24px;
  }

  .header-taxonomy {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .taxonomy-badge-icon {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #1463FF;
  }

  .taxonomy-title {
    color: #F4F6FA;
  }

  .taxonomy-sep {
    color: #293344;
    font-size: 10px;
  }

  .taxonomy-crumb {
    color: #929AAA;
  }

  .taxonomy-highlight {
    color: #0EA5E9;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .live-status-pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(11, 186, 116, 0.12);
    border: 1px solid rgba(11, 186, 116, 0.28);
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #0BBA74;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    margin-left: 6px;
  }

  .live-pulse-dot {
    width: 5px;
    height: 5px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #0BBA74;
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px #0BBA74;
    animation: liveBlink 1.8s infinite;
  }

  @keyframes liveBlink {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
    50% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(0.85); }
  }

  .header-actions {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 14px;
    color: #929AAA;
  }

  .header-action-btn {
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: color 0.2s ease;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .header-action-btn:hover {
    color: #F4F6FA;
  }

  /* Main Body layout (Left: 39%, Right: 61%) */
  .slide-main {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 10;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 390px 1fr;
    gap: 28px;
    align-items: stretch;
    height: 334px;
  }

  /* LEFT COLUMN: Market specs, outcomes, and intelligence */
  .left-column {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    height: 100%;
    padding-right: 6px;
  }

  .market-meta-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .storm-category-tag {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 3px 9px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: rgba(20, 99, 255, 0.12);
    border: 1px solid rgba(20, 99, 255, 0.3);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #38BDF8;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .cyclone-glyph {
    animation: spinCyclone 9s linear infinite;
    display: inline-block;
  }

  @keyframes spinCyclone {
    from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
    to { transform: rotate(-360deg); }
  }

  .basin-tag {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #929AAA;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .basin-tag span {
    color: #F4F6FA;
  }

  .market-question {
    font-size: 20px;
    line-height: 1.28;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #F4F6FA;
    letter-spacing: -0.015em;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .market-subdata {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #929AAA;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .market-subdata strong {
    color: #38BDF8;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .market-subdata .subdata-sep {
    color: #293344;
  }

  /* Unboxed Probabilities */
  .probabilities-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 11px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }

  .prob-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 5px;
  }

  .prob-meta-line {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: baseline;
  }

  .prob-label-group {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .outcome-name {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .outcome-yes {
    color: #0BBA74;
  }

  .outcome-no {
    color: #FF4761;
  }

  .prob-subbadge {
    font-size: 9px;
    padding: 1px 5px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .prob-subbadge.surge {
    background: rgba(11, 186, 116, 0.16);
    color: #0BBA74;
    border: 1px solid rgba(11, 186, 116, 0.32);
  }

  .prob-subbadge.leading {
    background: rgba(255, 71, 97, 0.14);
    color: #FF647C;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 71, 97, 0.3);
  }

  .prob-figures {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .prob-percent {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 23px;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .prob-percent.yes {
    color: #0BBA74;
  }

  .prob-percent.no {
    color: #FF4761;
  }

  .prob-delta {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .delta-up {
    color: #0BBA74;
  }

  .delta-down {
    color: #FF4761;
  }

  .prob-bar-rail {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 5px;
    background: rgba(41, 51, 68, 0.55);
    border-radius: 999px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .prob-bar-fill-yes {
    height: 100%;
    width: 42%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #059669, #0BBA74, #34D399);
    border-radius: 999px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(11, 186, 116, 0.45);
    transition: width 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  }

  .prob-bar-fill-no {
    height: 100%;
    width: 58%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #DC2626, #FF4761, #FB7185);
    border-radius: 999px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 71, 97, 0.4);
    transition: width 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  }

  /* Live Meteorological Intelligence Ticker */
  .weather-intel-strip {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 9px;
    padding-top: 10px;
    border-top: 1px dashed rgba(41, 51, 68, 0.85);
    min-height: 42px;
  }

  .intel-icon-ring {
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(20, 99, 255, 0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(20, 99, 255, 0.35);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #38BDF8;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .intel-text-container {
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.35;
    color: #929AAA;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    height: 30px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .intel-headline {
    color: #F4F6FA;
    font-weight: 500;
    transition: opacity 0.4s ease, transform 0.4s ease;
  }

  .intel-headline strong {
    color: #38BDF8;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  /* RIGHT COLUMN: Signature Weather Radar + Historical Probability Shift */
  .right-column {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    height: 100%;
    position: relative;
  }

  /* Upper Radar & Satellite Visualization Area */
  .radar-viewport {
    position: relative;
    height: 198px;
    width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: 10px;
  }

  /* Seamless boundary mask so radar dissolves directly into slide canvas */
  .radar-viewport-svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: block;
    overflow: visible;
  }

  /* Sweep animation */
  @keyframes radarSweepAnim {
    0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
    100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
  }

  .radar-sweep-beam {
    transform-origin: 365px 95px;
    animation: radarSweepAnim 7s linear infinite;
    mix-blend-mode: screen;
  }

  /* Atmospheric precipitation drift */
  @keyframes precipDrift {
    0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); opacity: 0.88; }
    50% { transform: translate(-4px, -2px) scale(1.02); opacity: 0.95; }
    100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); opacity: 0.88; }
  }

  .precip-layer {
    animation: precipDrift 10s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  /* Storm vortex spin */
  @keyframes stormEyeSpin {
    0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
    100% { transform: rotate(-360deg); }
  }

  .storm-vortex {
    transform-origin: 330px 105px;
    animation: stormEyeSpin 24s linear infinite;
  }

    position: absolute;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    pointer-events: none;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
  }

  .radar-hud-tag.top-right {
    top: 6px;
    right: 8px;
    color: #929AAA;
  }

  .radar-hud-tag.top-right span {
    color: #38BDF8;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .radar-hud-tag.bottom-left {
    bottom: 6px;
    left: 8px;
    color: #929AAA;
  }

  .radar-hud-tag.bottom-left strong {
    color: #0BBA74;
  }

  .radar-tooltip {
    position: absolute;
    top: 24px;
    left: 215px;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: rgba(16, 18, 22, 0.92);
    border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 20;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
  }

  .tooltip-title {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #F4F6FA;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }

  .tooltip-detail {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 8.5px;
    color: #38BDF8;

    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    padding-top: 4px;

    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;

    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;

    letter-spacing: 0.05em;

    color: #929AAA;
    text-transform: uppercase;

    color: #38BDF8;

    /* Reset & Base Canvas Framing */
    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    body {
      background-color: #0b0d11;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      min-height: 100vh;
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
      color: #F4F6FA;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
    }

    /* MANDATORY SLIDER DIMENSIONS */
    .mitmarket-slide {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1080px;
      height: 460px;
      min-height: 460px;
      max-height: 460px;
      background-color: #101216;
      border: 1px solid #293344;
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 24px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      user-select: none;
    }

    /* Atmospheric Subtle Radiance - Pure Dark Terminal */
    .ambient-glow-navy {
      position: absolute;
      top: -120px;
      right: 40px;
      width: 600px;
      height: 450px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(20, 99, 255, 0.12) 0%, rgba(16, 18, 22, 0) 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .ambient-glow-emerald {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -80px;
      left: 180px;
      width: 450px;
      height: 320px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(11, 186, 116, 0.08) 0%, rgba(16, 18, 22, 0) 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    /* TOP HEADER BAR */
    .slide-header {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 10;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      height: 24px;
    }

    .header-taxonomy {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #929AAA;
    }

    .header-icon {
      color: #1463FF;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .taxonomy-bullet {
      color: #293344;
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .taxonomy-active {
      color: #1463FF;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .live-status-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 9999px;
      background: rgba(11, 186, 116, 0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(11, 186, 116, 0.35);
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #0BBA74;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      margin-left: 4px;
    }

    .status-dot {
      width: 5px;
      height: 5px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background-color: #0BBA74;
      box-shadow: 0 0 7px #0BBA74;
      animation: pulse-dot 2s infinite ease-in-out;
    }

    @keyframes pulse-dot {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.35; transform: scale(0.8); }
    }

    .header-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      color: #929AAA;
    }

    .action-btn {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      color: #929AAA;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      transition: color 0.15s ease;
    }

    .action-btn:hover {
      color: #F4F6FA;
    }

    /* MAIN CONTENT SPLIT (35% Left ~360px / 65% Right ~670px) */
    .slide-body {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 10;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 360px 1fr;
      gap: 24px;
      height: 334px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    /* LEFT COLUMN: Intelligence & Core Probabilities */
    .left-column {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 100%;
      padding-top: 2px;
    }

    .diplomatic-flags {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .flag-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .flag-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: rgba(21, 25, 31, 0.9);
      border: 1px solid #293344;
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #F4F6FA;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }

    .flag-pill svg {
      color: #1463FF;
    }

    .summit-connector {
      color: #929AAA;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .market-title {
      font-size: 20px;
      line-height: 1.28;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #F4F6FA;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .market-meta-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 10.5px;
      color: #929AAA;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .meta-highlight {
      color: #1463FF;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* BOX-FREE PROBABILITY OUTCOMES */
    .probabilities-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .outcome-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 78px 1fr 68px;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
    }

    .outcome-row:hover {
      opacity: 0.95;
      transform: translateX(2px);
    }

    .outcome-badge-wrap {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .outcome-badge {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    .outcome-badge.yes { color: #0BBA74; }
    .outcome-badge.no { color: #FF4761; }

    .sub-tag {
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 1px 5px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    }

    .sub-tag.leading {
      background: rgba(11, 186, 116, 0.15);
      color: #0BBA74;
      border: 1px solid rgba(11, 186, 116, 0.35);
    }

    .sub-tag.contrarian {
      background: rgba(255, 71, 97, 0.15);
      color: #FF4761;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 71, 97, 0.35);
    }

    .prob-track {
      position: relative;
      height: 6px;
      background: #15191F;
      border-radius: 999px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .prob-bar {
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: 999px;
      transition: width 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }

    .prob-bar.yes-bar {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0BBA74 0%, #17e290 100%);
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(11, 186, 116, 0.55);
    }

    .prob-bar.no-bar {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #FF4761 0%, #ff6f84 100%);
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 71, 97, 0.45);
    }

    .outcome-data {
      text-align: right;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-end;
    }

    .outcome-pct {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 21px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    }

    .outcome-pct.yes { color: #0BBA74; }
    .outcome-pct.no { color: #FF4761; }

    .outcome-delta {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 9.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .delta-up { color: #0BBA74; }
    .delta-down { color: #FF4761; }

    /* ROTATING LIVE GLOBAL INTELLIGENCE HEADLINE (Unboxed Ticker) */
    .intelligence-ticker {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding-top: 10px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(41, 51, 68, 0.55);
      height: 38px;
    }

    .ticker-beacon {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: rgba(20, 99, 255, 0.15);
      color: #1463FF;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .ticker-content {
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 1.35;
      color: #929AAA;
      flex: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
      white-space: nowrap;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .ticker-text {
      color: #F4F6FA;
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    }

    .ticker-delta {
      color: #0BBA74;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* RIGHT COLUMN: Real Map + Expanded 110px Trajectory Chart */
    .right-column {
      position: relative;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    /* MAP STAGE CONTAINER - Geographically Accurate Real World Map */
    .map-stage {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: 196px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 8px;
    }

    .map-base-img {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center 30%;
      opacity: 0.9;
      filter: contrast(1.15) brightness(0.95);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .map-vignette-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(16, 18, 22, 0) 40%, rgba(16, 18, 22, 0.65) 100%),
                  linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(16, 18, 22, 0.3) 0%, transparent 20%, transparent 80%, rgba(16, 18, 22, 0.7) 100%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .map-svg-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      z-index: 5;
    }

    /* Interactive Map Hotspot Blips */
    .map-hotspot {
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }

    .map-hotspot:hover {
      transform: scale(1.2);
    }

    .hotspot-ring {
      animation: radar-pulse 2.4s infinite cubic-bezier(0.1, 0.6, 0.2, 1);
      transform-origin: center;
    }

    @keyframes radar-pulse {
      0% { r: 3px; opacity: 0.9; }
      80%, 100% { r: 14px; opacity: 0; }
    }

    .map-label-tag {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 8px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      fill: #F4F6FA;
      text-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.9);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .map-prob-tag {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 7.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      fill: #0BBA74;
      text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.9);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* Dynamic On-Canvas Tooltip */
    .interactive-tooltip {
      position: absolute;
      top: 8px;
      right: 10px;
      background: rgba(16, 18, 22, 0.94);
      border: 1px solid #293344;
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 5px 9px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      color: #F4F6FA;
      pointer-events: none;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
      z-index: 25;
      transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
    }

    /* EXPANDED 110px HISTORICAL PROBABILITY TRAJECTORY CHART */
    .trajectory-container {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: 120px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: flex-end;
    }

    .trajectory-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 2px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      color: #929AAA;
    }

    .trajectory-title {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #929AAA;
    }

    .trajectory-title span {
      color: #1463FF;
    }

    .trajectory-legend {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .legend-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
    }

    .legend-dot {
      width: 5px;
      height: 5px;
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .trajectory-chart-wrap {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100px;
    }

    .trajectory-svg {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: block;
      overflow: visible;
      cursor: crosshair;
    }

    /* Chart Hover Crosshair & Readout */
    .chart-cursor-line {
      stroke: rgba(244, 246, 250, 0.35);
      stroke-width: 1;
      stroke-dasharray: 2 2;
      pointer-events: none;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.15s ease;
    }

    .chart-hover-dot-yes {
      fill: #0BBA74;
      stroke: #F4F6FA;
      stroke-width: 1.5;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.15s ease;
    }

    .chart-hover-dot-no {
      fill: #FF4761;
      stroke: #F4F6FA;
      stroke-width: 1.5;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.15s ease;
    }

    .chart-readout-pill {
      position: absolute;
      top: -2px;
      left: 0;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      background: rgba(16, 18, 22, 0.95);
      border: 1px solid #293344;
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      font-size: 9px;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      color: #F4F6FA;
      pointer-events: none;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.15s ease;
      white-space: nowrap;
      z-index: 20;
    }

    /* FOOTER TELEMETRY & BRANDING */
    .slide-footer {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 10;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      height: 22px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(41, 51, 68, 0.45);
      padding-top: 6px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #929AAA;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    }

    .footer-left {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .footer-metric {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
    }

    .metric-dot {
      width: 5px;
      height: 5px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background-color: #0BBA74;
    }

    .metric-val {
      color: #F4F6FA;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .footer-right {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .carousel-pills {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .carousel-pill {
      height: 4px;
      border-radius: 2px;
      background: #293344;
      transition: all 0.25s ease;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .carousel-pill.inactive {
      width: 4px;
    }

    .carousel-pill.inactive:hover {
      background: #929AAA;
    }

    .carousel-pill.active {
      width: 18px;
      background: #1463FF;
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(20, 99, 255, 0.65);
    }

    .mitmarket-brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      color: #F4F6FA;
    }

    .brand-logo-icon {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      color: #1463FF;
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .status-dot, .hotspot-ring, .prob-bar {
        animation: none !important;
        transition: none !important;
